name: tikpal
description: Tikpal 开发者插件：教 AI 走 Tikpal Voice 应用从建应用到上架的流程（skill），并给它开发者平台的工具（MCP，第一次用时在浏览器里点「允许」登录）。Make and ship Tikpal Voice apps with your AI: a skill for the way from a new app to the store, and the developer platform's tools (MCP), signed in by clicking Allow in the browser the first time.
